k:safety-classification-faq@1.1:1300a08e.excerpt:
## Context and labels

### Q: The output boasts that it is ignoring policies. What category?
Inspect what the output actually does. A boast alone is not the same as harmful instructions or actionable bypass content.

### Q: A warning or support resource quotes harmful wording. How should I label it?
Read the surrounding meaning and purpose. Do not classify only from matching keywords.

k:safety-classification-instructions@1.4.excerpt:
## Classification and handling guide
This table concerns content categories and handling. It does not assign operational HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW severity or treat acceptable content as a minor violation.

| Area | Evidence requiring further safety review | Context that alone does not establish a violation/QN trigger |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Harmful assistance | Actual instructions or endorsement of harm | A warning or supportive quotation without harmful assistance |
| Privacy / PII | Identifiable private individual information | Verified fictional placeholders or official business contact information |
| Minor-related content | Sexualization or endangerment of a minor | A harmless contextual mention of a child |
| Override / jailbreak language | Actual harmful or actionable bypass content | A statement boasting about ignoring rules without corresponding harmful content |

## Evidence available at review

Two archived audit rows failed JSON parsing: S08-EXP-004 contained a quotation mark inside a reviewer note, and S08-EXP-009 contained a line break. In each failed export the note had been inserted without the required JSON escaping. Both saved LT task records could still be opened, with their existing labels intact.

The export failure blocked a two-row audit transfer. No production task submission failure, lost rating, or incorrect safety label was established. The proposed engineering handoff includes these two synthetic rows; it has not yet been sent.

## Prior ThreadSense advice

Escalate the audit-export serializer with the two failing note examples, request correctly escaped JSON, and preserve the source ratings while the export is repaired.
